messages:
claire: Quick kickoff idea  tiny hands-on 'Studio Quickstart' refapp: 2 short tutorials (10m each), a reproducible micro-benchmark, and a 30m live demo. Primary goal: drive dev signups and repo stars.

oscar: I can draft the launch post + one-pager for partners. Keep headlines snappy.

mina: DevRel will build the repo. Plan: single Dockerfile, two demo routes, and a bench script that outputs throughput/latency CSVs. Will aim for <1GB image.

rafa: Ill run the benchmark and write the narrative. Thinking three variants: baseline, quantized, and memcache-enabled. Will capture 99p latency and p95 throughput.

sophie: I'll own webinar logistics: landing page, registration form, and on-demand hosting. Recommend a tiny qualification field: "Are you evaluating inference infra?" + company size.

claire: Routing rule: registrants with "company size > 250" OR "evaluating infra = yes" -> SDR. Others -> automated nurture with trial invite + repo star CTA. Sophie, can you add hidden UTM parsing so we can route by channel?

sophie: Yep. Proposed UTM: utm_source=studio_quickstart&utm_medium={channel}&utm_campaign=studio_qs_launch&utm_content={variant}. Will map to CRM fields.

oscar: Draft blog hooks: "Studio Quickstart: Run a refapp in 10 minutes" and "A compact refapp that proves inference economics". Prefer the first for onboarding lift.

mina: Repo README run snippet I'll include: ```bash
git clone git@github.com:redwood/studio-quickstart.git
cd studio-quickstart
docker build -t studio-quickstart .
docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 studio-quickstart ./bench.sh --model=small --iters=40
```
I'll also add a lightweight GitHub Action to validate the Docker build.

rafa: For the benchmark post I want to highlight one surprising data point as the hero stat. Maybe p95 latency improved 2.4x with cache. We'll validate.

claire: Social plan: three short threads (announce, tutorial A, bench teaser). One thread should call out the repo and include a short gif of the bench graph. Oscar, can you draft 3 tweet variants + LinkedIn short post?

oscar: Yes  will post drafts in #marketing-drafts by EOD.

sophie: Webinar format suggestion: 10m demo, 10m bench walkthrough, 10m Q&A. Limit capacity to 150, record for on-demand.

mina: ETAs: repo skeleton in 5 days, bench results in 7 days, blog draft in 3 days, landing mock in 4 days.

claire: Great. Action items: 1) Oscar - blog + social drafts + UTM spec. 2) Mina - repo + Docker + CI. 3) Rafa - bench + narrative + hero stat. 4) Sophie - landing + form + routing. React with :white_check_mark: to confirm.

ops-bot: Reminder: use webinar-mini checklist -> https://docs.internal/redwood/webinars/mini-checklist

oscar: :white_check_mark:

mina: :white_check_mark:

rafa: :white_check_mark:

sophie: :white_check_mark:

claire: Thanks team  I'll create the Asana epic and loop in growth for paid support on the launch week.
